items.title: Quoted $18,500 for a 3-ton heat pump in Ohio. Am I getting ripped off?
items.pain_point: Homeowner faced with opaque quote markup and conflicting SEER2 efficiency claims.

matching_groundwork_asset.title: HVAC Heat Pump Replacement Cost & Payback Calculator

items.draft_preview: In Zone 4/5 (Ohio), wholesale equipment cost for a 3-ton 16 SEER2 inverter heat pump + air handler runs $4,800–$6,200. Labor and permitting is typically 12–16 man-hours ($2,400–$3,500). That puts fair installed cost around $8,500–$11,500 before rebates...

items.title: Is solar PV worth it in the UK with cloudy weather and Smart Export Guarantee (SEG)?
items.pain_point: UK homeowners confused about solar irradiance and realistic SEG tariff returns.

matching_groundwork_asset.title: Solar Panel ROI & Storage Break-Even Calculator

items.draft_preview: Even under diffuse cloud cover, modern monocrystalline panels produce 15-25% of rated capacity. The key financial lever in the UK is not export tariffs (SEG pays only 5-15p/kWh) but self-consumption arbitrage against the 24.5p price cap...
